raw_printing.name: Trifarian Captain
raw_printing.rules_html: When you play me, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal from among them a unit or gear with Energy cost no more than :rb_energy_3: and with Power cost no more than :rb_rune_rainbow: and draw it. Recycle the rest.
